'''Tuttle''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[colonel]] who worked for the [[New Republic]].<ref name="Chapter 21" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tuttle first appeared in "[[Chapter 21: The Pirate]]," the fifth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]], which was directed by [[Peter Ramsey]]. [[Tim Meadows]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Chapter 21" />
